```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(readr)

knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE)
```

## Read the inputs

The working merge supplies the computed chart runs. The case review
supplies the article evidence, reviewed run boundaries, and draft Bailey
assessments. Match the two files by `case_id`.

```{r read-inputs}
merged <- read_csv(
  "../data/processed/resurgence_pilot.csv",
  col_types = cols(
    .default = col_character(),
    confirmed_week = col_date(),
    original_release_date = col_date(),
    original_release_year = col_integer(),
    resurgence_start = col_date(),
    resurgence_end = col_date(),
    peak_rank = col_integer(),
    weeks_charted = col_integer(),
    age_at_resurgence_years = col_double()
  )
)

review <- read_csv(
  "../data/processed/resurgence_case_review.csv",
  col_types = cols(
    .default = col_character(),
    reviewed_start = col_date(),
    reviewed_end = col_date(),
    reviewed_peak_rank = col_integer(),
    reviewed_weeks = col_integer()
  )
)

stop_for_problems(merged)
stop_for_problems(review)

blank <- function(x) {
  is.na(x) | trimws(x) == ""
}

flag <- function(data, condition, description) {
  data |>
    filter({{ condition }}) |>
    transmute(case_id, song_title, issue = .env$description)
}

duplicate_ids <- function(data) {
  data |>
    count(case_id) |>
    filter(n > 1L) |>
    select(case_id)
}

merged_duplicates <- duplicate_ids(merged)
review_duplicates <- duplicate_ids(review)

# Leave ambiguous IDs out of the join so the report can list them as issues.
cases <- merged |>
  filter(!blank(case_id)) |>
  anti_join(merged_duplicates, by = "case_id") |>
  select(-any_of(c("article_url", "reported_period", "documented_trigger"))) |>
  left_join(
    review |>
      filter(!blank(case_id)) |>
      anti_join(review_duplicates, by = "case_id") |>
      select(-song_title),
    by = "case_id",
    relationship = "one-to-one"
  )
```

## Validation rules

Expect 15 cases and one row per case ID in each file. Each case needs an
article URL and reported comeback period. A trigger may be blank when
the article gives none.

The confirmed week must fall within the consecutive chart run. Peak rank
must be between 1 and 100, and the number of weeks must agree with the
run dates. Compare the computed run with the reviewed dates, peak rank,
and weeks charted.

Check the 10-year cutoff using the release anniversary. If only a
release year is available and the calendar-year difference is exactly
10, flag the case for a more precise date.

```{r apply-rules}
cases <- cases |>
  mutate(
    release_year_for_check = coalesce(
      as.integer(format(original_release_date, "%Y")),
      original_release_year
    ),
    year_gap = as.integer(format(resurgence_start, "%Y")) -
      release_year_for_check,
    meets_cutoff = case_when(
      year_gap > 10L ~ TRUE,
      year_gap < 10L ~ FALSE,
      year_gap == 10L & !is.na(original_release_date) ~
        format(resurgence_start, "%m-%d") >=
          format(original_release_date, "%m-%d"),
      TRUE ~ NA
    ),
    expected_age = round(
      as.numeric(resurgence_start - original_release_date) / 365.25,
      1
    )
  )

allowed_assessments <- c(
  "supports", "partly supports", "contradicts", "insufficient evidence"
)
```

## Validation table

```{r validation-table}
validation_issues <- bind_rows(
  tibble(case_id = "dataset", song_title = NA_character_, rows = nrow(merged)) |>
    filter(rows != 15L) |>
    transmute(case_id, song_title, issue = paste("Expected 15 merged rows. Found", rows)),
  flag(merged, blank(case_id), "Missing case ID in the working merge"),
  flag(review, blank(case_id), "Missing case ID in the evidence review"),
  flag(merged, case_id %in% merged_duplicates$case_id,
       "Duplicate case ID in the working merge"),
  flag(review, case_id %in% review_duplicates$case_id,
       "Duplicate case ID in the evidence review"),
  flag(merged, !blank(case_id) & !(case_id %in% review$case_id),
       "Missing matching evidence review"),
  flag(review, !blank(case_id) & !(case_id %in% merged$case_id),
       "Review case absent from the working merge"),
  flag(cases, blank(song_title) | blank(artist_name) | blank(recording_id),
       "Missing song, artist, or recording ID"),
  flag(cases, blank(article_url) | blank(reported_period),
       "Missing article URL or reported comeback period"),
  flag(cases, is.na(original_release_date) & is.na(original_release_year),
       "Missing original release date and year"),
  flag(cases, !is.na(original_release_date) & !is.na(original_release_year) &
         as.integer(format(original_release_date, "%Y")) != original_release_year,
       "Original release date and year disagree"),
  flag(cases, is.na(confirmed_week) | is.na(resurgence_start) |
         is.na(resurgence_end) | resurgence_end < resurgence_start |
         confirmed_week < resurgence_start | confirmed_week > resurgence_end,
       "Invalid chart dates or confirmed week outside the run"),
  flag(cases, is.na(peak_rank) | peak_rank < 1L | peak_rank > 100L,
       "Missing or invalid Hot 100 peak rank"),
  flag(cases, is.na(weeks_charted) | weeks_charted < 1L |
         as.integer(resurgence_end - resurgence_start) != 7L * (weeks_charted - 1L),
       "Weeks charted disagree with the run dates"),
  flag(cases, is.na(meets_cutoff), "10-year cutoff could not be confirmed"),
  flag(cases, !meets_cutoff, "Below the 10-year cutoff"),
  flag(cases, !is.na(expected_age) &
         (is.na(age_at_resurgence_years) |
            abs(age_at_resurgence_years - expected_age) > 1e-8),
       "Age at resurgence disagrees with the release date and run start"),
  flag(cases, !(boundary_status %in% "reviewed") |
         is.na(reviewed_start) | is.na(reviewed_end) |
         is.na(reviewed_peak_rank) | is.na(reviewed_weeks) |
         resurgence_start != reviewed_start | resurgence_end != reviewed_end |
         peak_rank != reviewed_peak_rank | weeks_charted != reviewed_weeks,
       "Chart run needs review or differs from the evidence review"),
  flag(cases, !(bailey_assessment %in% allowed_assessments) |
         blank(bailey_prediction) | blank(bailey_rationale),
       "Missing or invalid Bailey assessment")
) |>
  distinct() |>
  arrange(case_id, issue)

if (nrow(validation_issues) == 0L) {
  cat("All", nrow(cases), "cases passed the checks in this report.")
} else {
  knitr::kable(validation_issues)
}
```

## Case review

Hot 100 ranks measure overall chart performance. The Bailey assessments
also depend on what the article evidence says about the listeners who
drove the comeback.

```{r reviewed-cases}
cases |>
  select(
    case_id, song_title, resurgence_start, resurgence_end,
    peak_rank, weeks_charted, meets_cutoff, boundary_status, review_note
  ) |>
  knitr::kable()

cases |>
  select(
    case_id, song_title, article_url, reported_period, documented_trigger,
    bailey_prediction, bailey_assessment, bailey_rationale
  ) |>
  knitr::kable()
```

## Descriptive summaries

```{r descriptive-summaries}
cases |>
  select(age_at_resurgence_years, peak_rank, weeks_charted) |>
  summary()

cases |>
  mutate(documented_trigger = if_else(
    blank(documented_trigger), "No trigger documented", documented_trigger
  )) |>
  count(documented_trigger, sort = TRUE) |>
  knitr::kable()

cases |>
  count(bailey_assessment, sort = TRUE) |>
  knitr::kable()
```

## Export the dashboard dataset

```{r export-dashboard}
stopifnot(
  nrow(validation_issues) == 0L,
  nrow(cases) == 15L,
  anyDuplicated(cases$case_id) == 0L
)

readr::write_csv(
  cases,
  "../data/processed/resurgence_dashboard.csv",
  na = ""
)
```
